name: Amanita Citron
source:
After saving Amanita, the kingdom stages a grand festival – mostly coincidental, but she gets to take the credit. You, her favorite shopkeeper who kept her stocked through it all, are invited to dine with her afterward.

[From [url=https://yami-savvy.itch.io/amanita-citron]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
拯救阿玛尼塔后，王国举办了一场盛大的节日——这大多是巧合，但她却获得了功劳。你，她最喜欢的店主，在整个过程中为她备货充足，随后被邀请与她一起用餐。

[来自[url=https://yami-savvy.itch.io/amanita-citron]Itch.io[/url]]
